title: Three Days and One Short Ladder
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（人与社会·科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（人与社会·科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：inspection　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 inspection 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the auditor ① completed the inspection that no worker in the tunnel would have recorded, and he said the completing was the whole of the day. The ② inspection, meaning the check itself and not the ladder, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; a inspection, he said, is the only thing in a tunnel that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ inspection in that tunnel had the same short ladder beside it, and the ④ inspection at the far joint, meaning the report they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A inspection, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the auditor said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the inspection was the whole of the matter, meaning the standard and not the check. The ⑥ inspection, meaning the standard and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; inspection, he said, is either something you complete or the only word that means both a check and a standard. He said the standard is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ inspection had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short ladder. The ⑧ inspection of the whole thing, the auditor wrote in March, was one tunnel and three days of recording; inspection, he said, is either the report at the far joint or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ inspection I remember is the check recorded in the log, which closed in 1996 and is still recorded as the quietest in the tunnel. A ⑩ inspection, my mother said in 1998, is the only check that improves by being recorded; every inspection, she said, is a standard that has agreed to look like a check. She said the standard was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 检查；视察（指隧道里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 检查；视察（指那次检查本身，与梯子相对）
C. 固定搭配：complete the inspection 完成这次检查
D. n. 检查；视察（指留给孩子们照着抄的一份那一次）
E. n. 查验之事（抽象总称，指一处隧道的检查之事）
F. n. 检查；视察（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一次）
G. n. 标准、规范（指一件事里人人都查却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 规范（抽象总称，指人人都查却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: completed the inspection that no worker in the tunnel would have recorded
The inspection, meaning the check itself and not the ladder
the inspection at the far joint
the inspection was the whole of the matter
the inspection had become a line in a log
The inspection of the whole thing
A inspection, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: complete the inspection 意为“完成这次检查”，1989 年那位核查员把隧道里没有一位工人肯记录的一次检查做了一遍。
inspection 意为“检查；视察”，指那次检查本身而不是梯子，它经过了三个天而在簿子上没有被记录。
inspection 意为“检查；视察”，指隧道里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一架窄窄的梯子。
inspection 意为“检查；视察”，指最远那处接缝处留给孩子们照着抄的一份那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
inspection 意为“标准、规范”，指一件事里人人都查却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个标准就是那件事的全部。
inspection 意为“规范”，指人人都查却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次检查，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
inspection 意为“检查；视察”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一次，到 1994 年这一次成了记录里的一行。
inspection 意为“查验之事”，核查员三月写道，整件事的检查之事是一处隧道和三个天的记录。
inspection 意为“检查；视察”，我记得的是记录里记录过的那一次，1996 年结束了，至今仍被说成隧道里最安静的一次。
inspection 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，检查是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的检查。
